feature_name: Birthday special events from Google Contacts
summary: The Calendar API can access birthdays and other special events automatically created from Google Contacts, including birthday-specific metadata in birthdayProperties.
extended_definition: The Calendar API can access birthdays and other special events automatically created from Google Contacts, including birthday-specific metadata in birthdayProperties.
